item.description: After the Japan trip I slowed down on side projects for a bit, then designed a tiny cube vase for small flowers.

item.title: Build-your-tank Dev Log #1
item.description: Started a physical prototype for a build-your-tank style boardgame with CAD on a 3×3×3 grid, spring pins, and a circle pin that almost works.

item.title: Bought a 3D Printer!
item.description: Late October 2025 I finally pulled the trigger on a Bambu Lab A1, AMS Lite, filaments, and a lot of messing around in FreeCAD.
